title: Maximum Profit in Job Scheduling
description: Find the maximum profit of non-overlapping jobs given start times, end times, and profits.
pseudocode:
1. jobs = sort(jobs by end time)
2. dp = [[0, 0]]
3. for each [s, e, p] in jobs:
4.   idx = binarySearch(dp, s)
5.   currProfit = p + dp[idx][1]
6.   if currProfit > dp.last[1]:
7.     dp.push([e, currProfit])

steps.note: Processing job [1, 3, 50]. Last compatible end time is 0.
Processing job [2, 4, 10]. Binary search for end time <= 2: index 0.
Processing job [3, 5, 40]. Binary search for end time <= 3: index 1 (value 50).
Push [5, 90] to DP. Max profit is 90.
